title: Article: Why People Can’t Do Sadhanas (Spiritual Practices)

segments.text: Understanding the Spiritual Blockages

Many people struggle to perform sadhanas (spiritual practices) because of unseen obstacles in the astral world. Ashaeiynn, a spiritual organization, studies these hidden forces using “Drishti” (3rd eye). Drishti helps individuals see the truth behind their struggles and understand the deeper science of spiritual rituals.
The Power of Devotion

True devotion makes a person independent. When you surrender to divine energy, you no longer need external support. If your devotion makes you dependent on others, then it is not true devotion. Real spiritual practice connects you directly with Gurudev (spiritual master), strengthens your Drishti, and empowers you to heal yourself and your loved ones.
However, many spiritual places do not want people to awaken their Drishti. They want followers to remain dependent on them for solutions, so they can continue to exploit them.
How Ancestors (Pitr) Block Spiritual Growth

The biggest obstacles to Drishti are ancestors (Pitr) and negative energies. Ancestors who have not moved on to the higher lok(realms) influence their lineage (vanshaj) and create blockages in their spiritual path. Once a person develops Drishti, they can see that their ancestors may be the reason behind their struggles, illnesses, and misfortunes.
For example, if a person’s mother suffers from frequent chest pain, medical treatment may not provide relief. But with Drishti, one may see that an ancestor is sitting on her chest, causing the pain.

Ancestors can also manipulate family members. If someone in the house begins chanting “Initiated Mantra” they may face sudden conflicts at home. This happens because the ancestors fear that chanting will activate Drishti and reveal their presence. Even if a person continues chanting, the ancestors might drain their spiritual energy, preventing them from gaining true benefits.
The Role of Ancestors and Deities

Ancestors have the power to block Drishti but cannot change one’s fate. Only deities can influence destiny. The divine realm (Dev Lok) exists below the ancestor realm (Pitr Lok). Those pitr’s who have been sent to Pitr Lok cannot return to earth, but imagine ancestors who are haven’t got place in pitr lok & still roaming around on earth acts like negative entities and should not be considered as true ancestors (pitr).

These entities attach themselves to family members, causing physical and emotional distress. Symptoms include constant leg pain and sudden mood swings of the head of the family. When these ancestors are removed, the person can finally connect with divine energy, receive blessings from their ancestral deity, and awaken their Drishti.
How Ashaeiynn Helps in Awakening Drishti
When a person joins Ashaeiynn, they are guided by Gurudev to remove pitr & negative influences and awaken their Drishti. Common traits among Ashaeiynn followers include:
A strong spiritual connection with Gurudev.
Suffering due to Pitr Dosh (ancestral blockages).
Experiencing struggles despite having a good astrological chart.

Many people consult astrologers who predict a prosperous life based on their birth chart. However, their real-life struggles do not match the predictions. This happens because astrology does not show hidden blockages like black magic, ancestral issues (pitr dosh), or curses. By following Gurudev’s guidance and practicing mantras, people can overcome these hidden obstacles and change their destiny.
Bhaiya Ji’s Experience

Bhaiya Ji, once consulted an astrologers who predicted his life full of struggles and limitations. However, after coming under Gurudev’s guidance, his life transformed. Gurudev taught him sacred knowledge not found in any scriptures. Though he faced many tests, after five and a half years, Gurudev finally awakened his Drishti and removed all negative influences from his life.
Importance of Awakening Drishti
Bhaiya Ji emphasizes the need to awaken Drishti for several reasons:
When visiting a temple, Drishti helps see which divine energy is present and how to connect with it.
If problems arise at home, Drishti can determine whether the issue is physical or astral and how to resolve it.
Instead of seeking help from others, Drishti allows a person to directly consult Gurudev for guidance.
Conclusion

Drishti is the key to become independent in the spiritual journey. It helps individuals see the truth, remove negative influences, and connect with divine energies. Many forces, including pitrs, try to block this awakening drishti because it exposes their control. However, with the guidance of Gurudev and consistent practice of mantras, anyone can overcome these barriers and unlock their true spiritual potential.
